name: A New Cloak's Sheen
summary: Krueg Skullsplitter has come down to Feralas with companions, sent by their masters in Orgrimmar. Krueg plans a cloak for life-mate Korrin and asks you for ten Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings.

sections.title: A Cloak for Korrin
sections.body: Krueg and companions came down to Feralas, sent by their masters in Orgrimmar. Krueg's life-mate Korrin loves new clothes, so Krueg plans a cloak adorned with the delicate wings of faerie dragons. The sprite darters with the beautiful wings Krueg wants live west of Camp Mojache, and Krueg asks you for ten Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings.

sections.title: Krueg's Warning
sections.body: Krueg cautions that provoked sprite darters are risky. Krueg says to be even more careful around night elves nearby, who tend to hole up in the forests too.

faq.answer: Krueg Skullsplitter is at Camp Mojache. Krueg came down to Feralas with companions, sent by their masters in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does Krueg want sprite darter wings?
faq.answer: Krueg plans a cloak for life-mate Korrin, who loves new clothes, adorned with faerie dragon wings.

faq.q: Where are the sprite darters located?
aliases: where are faerie dragons in feralas

faq.q: What dangers does Krueg warn about?
faq.answer: Krueg says provoked sprite darters are risky, and that night elves nearby, who also tend to hole up in the forests, call for even more care.
